Players Committee card image of [[An Inkling Of Its Destructive Potential (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploy on table. Once per game, may take a [Set 9] Epic Event into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your deploy phase, if Krennic on Death Star, may flip Set Your Course For Alderaan (flip back at end of turn). (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/aninklingofitsdestructivepotential.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/d964b9d2b84751f0991debc21c4f7ff08a33b17e d964b9d] (26 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.
